body:
Track 5 follow-up to simdesign-meshconverge. With the assumed slenderness limit raised from 8 to 12.5, gauge-2 bracket webs of 16-17 mm and wider are feasible at h = 1.5, 1.0, 0.75 mm; refinement raises the lightest feasible width by one 0.5 mm step (about 1 g). Relaxed rule stands in for buckling, which is unvalidated. Stylised, preliminary.
